title: Technology Sector Update for 11/29/2018: JNPR,FSCT,VEEV
text:

GOOG +0.11%
Technology stocks were weaker Thursday, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing 0.9% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index was slipping nearly 0.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Juniper Networks ( JNPR ) retreated Thursday, sliding almost 3%, after it announced plans to buy HTBASE in a move intended to expand its portfolio of multicloud products for business customers. Privately held HTBASE has developed software tools allowing enterprises to pool compute, network and store data from local infrastructure and also transfer data and virtual machines within their local IT infrastructure and outside cloud servers without transformation. The proposed transaction is expected to close before the end of the year. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
In other sector news:
(+) ForeScout Technologies ( FSCT ) climbed almost 4% on Thursday after Berenberg Bank began coverage of the network security software firm with a buy rating.
(+) Veeva Systems ( VEEV ) was back on positive ground this afternoon, recovering from a nearly 4% decline earlier in the session, after late Wednesday posting Q3 financial results exceeding Wall Street expectations. The cloud-computing company focused on the life sciences sector earned $0.45 per share, excluding items, beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.07 per share. Revenue grew 26.9% year over year to $224.7 million, also topping the $216 million analyst mean.
